shapes.Transform: Changes how a rule works, so a package plays differently.
shapes.Convert: Turns one resource or event into another, so a package feeds a second one.
shapes.Bridge: Joins two packages: each makes the other better.
shapes.Amplify: Scales one package, with a condition you build toward.
shapes.Setup: Puts something on the board or in hand at the start, then gets out of the way.
shapes.Engine: Stores or spreads something over a combat; grows the more you lean in.

relics.name: Pilgrim Boots
relics.text: Gain 1 extra movement each turn. Your Move leaves radius-1 Light for 2 turns along its path; a Blink lights both ends.
relics.intrinsic: An extra tile of movement every turn.
relics.extrinsic: The Light trail feeds Beaconrunner Spurs, Sunlit Edge and Unclouded Sun.
relics.note: Kept. A clean movement common that already reaches into Radiance.

relics.name: Quarry Winch
relics.text: When you Push or Pull an enemy standing on Rubble, you may consume the Rubble to aim in any cardinal direction.
relics.intrinsic: Free redirection whenever a target stands on Rubble; broken terrain and Earth enemies leave plenty.
relics.extrinsic: Rubble becomes aiming fuel: point every shove at a wall, an outcrop or another enemy.
relics.note: Kept. Its sideways and away pulls already travel their full line.

relics.name: Rimecatcher Vial
relics.text: When your attack Freezes an enemy, you may move one of the Ice tiles it consumed to a tile next to the target.
relics.intrinsic: Keeps a little Ice on the board after a Freeze.
relics.extrinsic: An Ice deck can Freeze, then Freeze the neighbour.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Tailwind Fletching
relics.text: Your Air Push and Pull deal 1 more damage and move targets 1 tile farther.
relics.intrinsic: Every Air shove is a little stronger.
relics.extrinsic: Under the collision rule, one more tile is 2 more damage whenever the line is blocked.
relics.note: Kept. The collision rule quietly made it better.

relics.name: Reinforced Shield
relics.text: While you have Stoneskin, your Block cards grant 3 more Block.
relics.intrinsic: Bigger Block in any deck that touches Stoneskin.
relics.extrinsic: Grave Dirt, Rubblewalker Greaves and Ashen Phylactery keep it switched on.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Static Soles
relics.text: Your first Move or Blink each turn leaves Electrified on the tile you left and grants Vision 1 for 2 turns.
relics.extrinsic: Walk a line of Electrified for conduction, Grounding Pin and Copper-Shod Staff.
relics.note: Kept. It is a once-per-turn trigger, but it builds the board instead of handing out cards.

relics.name: Hourglass Awl
relics.text: Attacks on cards that cost 6 or more Time gain Pierce.
relics.was: Attacks on cards with Time 7+ gain Pierce.
relics.intrinsic: Heavy weapons and big spells ignore Block.
relics.extrinsic: Pairs with Hourglass Splinter and Leaden Pommel in slow, heavy decks.
relics.note: Threshold lowered from 7 to 6: 7+ covered 14 cards, 6+ covers 40.

relics.name: Iron Buckler
relics.text: At the start of your turn, keep up to 3 of your Block.
relics.was: The first card each turn with Block or Stoneskin and no attacks draws 1.
relics.intrinsic: Block stops being all-or-nothing between turns.
relics.extrinsic: Holds Block thresholds open for Anchor Chain, Briar Vambrace and Cold Mirror.
relics.note: Replaces a draw trigger with a rule. Big Block turns now carry a little forward. The dragon benchmark build uses this relic and needs re-running.

relics.name: Coffin Nails
relics.text: When your Block stops all of an enemy attack's damage, the attacker gains Bleed 1.
relics.was: While you have Block, attacks on your cards inflict Bleed +1.
relics.intrinsic: Any Block deck punishes the enemies it walls off.
relics.extrinsic: Bleeding attackers feed Funeral Bell and lose health as they keep moving and swinging.
relics.note: The old version gave your attacks Bleed while you had Block. This one makes the Block itself the weapon.

relics.name: Duelist Whetstone
relics.text: Attacks on cards that also Move or Blink deal 1 more damage for each tile you've traveled this turn (max 3 more).
relics.was: Attacks on the first card each turn that also uses Move or Blink deal +2 damage.
relics.extrinsic: Counts independent movement too: walk first, then lunge. Feint Ribbon and Fencer's Gloves want the same turn.
relics.note: Uses the tiles-moved count the card overhaul added.

relics.name: Flint Edge
relics.text: Your melee attacks consume the Fire, Ice or Electrified under their target to deal 3 more damage.
relics.was: Your melee attacks deal +2 damage to enemies standing on Fire.
relics.intrinsic: Melee can cash in any ground an enemy stands on, including the enemy's own.
relics.extrinsic: Gives melee decks a stake in every element's surfaces.
relics.note: Automatic, with no toggle: the hover forecast shows the tile being spent. Consumed Ice does not Freeze. It was +2 damage on Fire only.

relics.name: Recoil Plates
relics.text: You take 1 Collision damage per lost tile instead of 2. Whenever you are part of a Collision, gain 3 Block.
relics.intrinsic: Blunts every enemy shove and Air trap.
relics.extrinsic: Lets you stand at the end of your own collision lanes.
relics.note: Ash Hounds, Gallows Rocs, Stoneback Mites and Vaeloryx all push you into things now. This is the answer.

relics.name: Millstone Fob
relics.text: When an enemy you Push or Pull collides, the tile it stopped on becomes Rubble.
relics.intrinsic: Rubble slows enemies walking back toward you.
relics.extrinsic: Collisions now feed every Rubble payoff: Quarry Signet, Quarry Winch, Basalt Kiln, Worldroot Idol.
relics.note: The seed of the Wrecking Yard build.

relics.name: Tallow Candle
relics.text: At the start of each combat, create radius-2 Light on your tile for 3 turns.
relics.intrinsic: Starts every fight with sight and a lit tile, whatever the Umbra.
relics.extrinsic: Counts as a Light source for Captured Noon and a lit start for Sunlit Edge.

relics.name: Pocket Sundial
relics.text: If you use both card plays in a turn, your next turn comes 2 Time sooner.
relics.intrinsic: Using both base plays earns 2 Time without changing card costs.
relics.extrinsic: Fast two-card turns and Quicken; with Toll of the Late Bell, acting sooner means more enemies are late.
relics.note: Shown on the turn order rail as your next turn moving earlier.

relics.name: Leaden Pommel
relics.text: Attacks on cards that cost 5 or more Time Stagger 1.
relics.intrinsic: Slow, heavy attacks also slow the enemy.
relics.extrinsic: Stacks with printed Stagger. Overflow past the limit feeds Pendulum Weight.

relics.name: Pitch Gloves
relics.text: Fire deals you 1 less damage. Fire you create deals enemies 1 more.
relics.intrinsic: Takes the sting out of enemy Fire and Fire traps.
relics.extrinsic: Fire decks can stand in their own fields and burn harder.

relics.name: Hobnail Cleats
relics.text: Ice doesn't make you Chilled. While you stand on Ice, your Ice attacks deal 2 more damage.
relics.extrinsic: Ice decks fight from their own field.

relics.name: Grounding Pin
relics.text: Your single-target attacks against an enemy standing on Electrified gain Chain 1.
relics.intrinsic: Any attack can jump when the ground is charged, including enemy and trap Electrified.
relics.extrinsic: Lightning decks aim at the network instead of at the target.
relics.note: Replaces Ion Spool's draw trigger with an aiming rule.

relics.name: Rubblewalker Greaves
relics.text: Rubble doesn't slow you. Start each turn standing on Rubble with 1 Stoneskin.
relics.intrinsic: Broken ground stops taxing your movement.
relics.extrinsic: Earth decks live on their own Rubble.

relics.name: Grave Dirt
relics.text: Start each combat with 4 Stoneskin.
relics.intrinsic: A safer first turn in any deck.
relics.extrinsic: Switches on Reinforced Shield, Faultline Brooch, Stonefist and Iron Lung from turn one.
relics.note: Simple on purpose: a common that opens other relics.

relics.name: Waxen Effigy
relics.text: At the start of each combat, create a 2-health illusion on the empty tile next to you nearest an enemy.
relics.intrinsic: A free decoy to soak the first hit.
relics.extrinsic: Starts illusion payoffs on turn one: Widow Thread, Mirror Shard, Changeling's Rattle.

relics.name: Quick-Draw Bandolier
relics.text: Your items don't use a card play, but cost 1 more Time.
relics.intrinsic: Items become free actions on top of your two plays.
relics.extrinsic: Item-heavy loadouts turn every turn into three or four actions.

relics.name: Briar Vambrace
relics.text: When a card gives you Block, also gain Retaliate 1 until your next turn.
relics.intrinsic: Every Block card has a few thorns.
relics.extrinsic: Retaliate decks stack it; Martyr's Gorget turns it back into Block.

relics.name: Fencer's Gloves
relics.text: Your second card each turn costs 1 less Time.
relics.intrinsic: Every two-card turn is a little faster.
relics.extrinsic: Follow-up cards want to be second; so do heavy finishers.

relics.name: Brightglass Lens
relics.text: Your ranged attacks against an enemy standing in Light gain Chain 1.
relics.intrinsic: Lit targets become Chain starts for any ranged deck.
relics.extrinsic: Radiance lights the board; Lightning uses it.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Shatterglass Prism
relics.text: When your attack kills a Frozen enemy, Rubble appears under it and on each tile next to it.
relics.extrinsic: Ice kills feed Earth's Rubble payoffs.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Anchor Chain
relics.text: While you have Block, your Push and Pull deal 2 more damage and move targets 1 tile farther.
relics.extrinsic: One more tile is 2 more collision damage: Block decks hit like walls.
relics.note: Kept. The collision rule made its extra tile worth damage.

relics.name: Updraft Bottle
relics.text: When you Push or Pull an enemy off an elemental tile, you may carry that surface to where it lands.
relics.extrinsic: Drag a Fire tile into a Detonate cluster, or Ice to a wall.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Basalt Kiln
relics.text: Your Detonate may consume Rubble instead of Fire; the spent tiles become Fire.
relics.intrinsic: Rubble you already have becomes Detonate fuel.
relics.extrinsic: Earth fuels Fire, and leaves Fire for the next Detonate.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Stormcoal Crucible
relics.text: Fire tiles also conduct Lightning. Attacks conducted through them consume them.
relics.extrinsic: Fire fields become Lightning networks.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Widow Thread
relics.text: While you have an illusion, your attacks Expose 1.
relics.intrinsic: Any deck with an illusion hits harder on the follow-up.
relics.extrinsic: Waxen Effigy turns it on from turn one.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Thawing Charm
relics.text: Healing beyond your maximum becomes Stoneskin (up to 8 each turn). The first conversion each turn creates radius-1 Light on you for 2 turns.
relics.extrinsic: Healing cards and items become armour.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Storm Capacitor
relics.text: Your Lightning ranged attacks with Chain gain Chain 1.
relics.intrinsic: Chain cards reach one more enemy.
relics.extrinsic: Pairs with Resonant Clapper and Storm Crown.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Iron Lung
relics.text: Every Health Cost, including an Empower cost, is paid from your Stoneskin first, at 2 Stoneskin per Health.
relics.was: The first health-cost card you play each turn grants 3 Stoneskin.
relics.intrinsic: A safety valve for any card that costs health.
relics.extrinsic: Blood and Empower decks can spend armour instead of life.
relics.note: Moved from common to rare. It was a once-per-turn Stoneskin trigger on health-cost cards.

relics.name: Hourglass Splinter
relics.text: When you play a card that costs 6 or more Time, Quicken 2.
relics.was: The first card with Time 7+ each turn grants 1 card play and 4 Block.
relics.intrinsic: A heavy card makes the next one cheap.
relics.extrinsic: Heavy opener, cheap Follow-up second card; stacks with Fencer's Gloves.

relics.name: Chorus Mask
relics.text: A card whose element differs from the last card you played this turn deals 2 more damage and grants 2 more Block.
relics.was: The first elemental card played after a different element each turn grants 1 card play and 3 Block.
relics.intrinsic: Mixed decks get a bonus on alternating turns.
relics.extrinsic: Two-school decks alternate on purpose.
relics.note: Keeps the variety idea and drops the extra card play.

relics.name: Gale Tabi
relics.text: After you Blink, your next attack this turn deals 1 more damage for each tile that Blink spanned (max 4 more).
relics.was: The first Blink of 3+ each turn draws 1 and grants 1 card play.
relics.extrinsic: Long Blinks into big hits; pairs with Feint Ribbon.

relics.name: Mirror Shard
relics.text: When your Illusion is destroyed, it shatters, dealing 3 damage to each enemy next to it.
relics.was: The first card that creates an illusion each turn grants 1 card play and Vision 1.
relics.extrinsic: Hall of Mirrors becomes a minefield; Hollow Puppet throws the mines.

relics.name: Quarry Signet
relics.text: Enemies standing on Rubble take 1 more damage from everything: attacks, Collision, Fire and Retaliate.
relics.was: Your attacks deal +2 damage to enemies standing on Rubble.
relics.extrinsic: Rubble-making decks multiply every hit.
relics.note: Broader than the old +2 to attacks: collisions and passive damage count too.

relics.name: Ember Siphon
relics.text: When an enemy dies while standing on Fire, Fire spreads to each empty tile next to where it fell.
relics.was: Once per combat, an enemy killed by your Fire or Detonate heals 3 and leaves Light.
relics.intrinsic: Enemy and trap Fire becomes fuel too.
relics.extrinsic: Fire decks kill on their own fields, and every kill refuels the next Detonate.

relics.name: Beaconrunner Spurs
relics.text: Each tile of your Light you enter during a Move refunds 1 movement (max 2 each turn).
relics.was: The first Move or Blink each turn that ends in Light grants 1 card play and 3 Block.
relics.extrinsic: Radiance decks move farther than anyone.

relics.name: Feint Ribbon
relics.text: If you've traveled 2 or more tiles this turn, your first card counts as a Follow-up.
relics.extrinsic: Follow-up cards fire on card one, so both of your plays carry a bonus.

relics.name: Battering Yoke
relics.text: When an enemy you Push or Pull collides with another enemy, that enemy is knocked 1 tile in the same direction, colliding normally if it can't move.
relics.extrinsic: One shove moves a whole cluster into the wall.

relics.name: Pendulum Weight
relics.text: Stagger beyond an enemy's per-turn limit is dealt to it as damage instead.
relics.extrinsic: The Stagger cap stops being a ceiling.

relics.name: Martyr's Gorget
relics.text: When your Retaliate damages an attacker, gain that much Block.
relics.intrinsic: Some armour back whenever thorns fire.
relics.extrinsic: Thorns refill your Block mid-enemy-turn; Briar Vambrace makes every Block card count.

relics.name: Reliquary Box
relics.text: Your opening hand includes a Rite from your deck, if you have one. Each Rite costs 1 less Time.
relics.extrinsic: Your Rite is down by turn one, every combat.

relics.name: Changeling's Rattle
relics.text: When an enemy destroys your Illusion, that enemy suffers Stagger 3 and Expose 2.
relics.intrinsic: Any decoy delays the enemy who breaks it.
relics.extrinsic: Illusion decks bait enemies down the turn clock.

relics.name: Copper-Shod Staff
relics.text: Your outcrops and Illusion count as Electrified for your Lightning: they conduct and carry Chain, and take no damage from it.
relics.extrinsic: Walls and decoys become relays.

relics.name: Ashen Phylactery
relics.text: When you Exhaust a card, gain Stoneskin equal to the Time you paid for it (max 5).
relics.extrinsic: Every Rite is also a Stoneskin card.

relics.name: Bonded Set
relics.text: Cards from an equipment piece that shares its element with another equipped piece deal 1 more damage and grant 1 more Block.
relics.extrinsic: A fire weapon and fire boots both improve.

relics.name: Overclock Coil
relics.text: When you Empower a card, Quicken 2.
relics.extrinsic: Pays back Empower's Time; health and Exhaust Empowers become tempo.

relics.name: Fetter Spikes
relics.text: Enemies with Immobilize take double Collision damage.
relics.extrinsic: Pin it, then slam it.

relics.name: Mason's Plumb
relics.text: Your outcrops have 2 more health. An enemy that collides with one of your outcrops takes 2 more damage, and the outcrop takes none.
relics.extrinsic: Build the wall, then shove enemies into it.

relics.name: Bloodglass Knife
relics.text: While at half health or less with no Block or Stoneskin, your attacks deal 7 more damage.
relics.intrinsic: A comeback edge at real risk.
relics.extrinsic: Health-cost decks live under the line on purpose.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Thunder Relay
relics.text: Your Chain attacks may swap their first and last enemy targets if both survive.
relics.extrinsic: Chain becomes repositioning.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Faultline Brooch
relics.text: You may spend 4 Stoneskin to turn a single-target melee attack into a cross that leaves Rubble.
relics.extrinsic: Stoneskin decks spend armour on area attacks.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Obsidian Heart
relics.text: Draw 1 fewer card in your opening hand. At the end of your turn, your remaining Block becomes Stoneskin.
relics.intrinsic: All Block persists, at a cost of one opening card.
relics.extrinsic: Block decks build a permanent wall.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Captured Noon
relics.text: With 3 of your Light sources active, Umbra is 1 stage lower; with 6, it is 2 stages lower.
relics.extrinsic: Light decks hold the room clear.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Sunlit Edge
relics.text: While you stand in Light, your attacks Pierce.
relics.intrinsic: Fight from a lit tile and ignore Block.
relics.extrinsic: Radiance decks keep a lit tile under you.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Witchglass Carapace
relics.text: Enemy ranged attacks deal at most 1 damage to your illusions.
relics.extrinsic: Decoys survive ranged enemies.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Cold Mirror
relics.text: When you Freeze an enemy while you have 4 or more Block, your Block hardens: lose all your Block and gain 1 Crystal Mantle layer for every 4 lost (max 2).
relics.was: Once per turn, inflicting Freeze while you have Block converts up to 6 Block into Stoneskin.
relics.extrinsic: Each Mantle layer cancels a whole hit: a Freeze turn becomes a shield.
relics.note: Uses the Mantle mechanic from the card overhaul.

relics.name: Vaulting Sigil
relics.text: Your Move can pass through enemies (you can't stop on one). Each enemy you pass through suffers Stagger 2.
relics.was: The first Move or Blink of 4+ each turn grants 1 card play and 4 Block.
relics.extrinsic: Run through the line, delaying each enemy you pass.

relics.name: Overflow Censer
relics.text: When you place Fire, Ice or Electrified on a tile holding a different one of them, it also spreads to each empty tile next to it.
relics.was: Once per combat, having 3 different surface types in view grants 6 Stoneskin and draw 2.
relics.intrinsic: Nothing without two schools of ground.
relics.extrinsic: Mixed boards grow every time you overwrite.

relics.name: Funeral Bell
relics.text: When an enemy dies with 2 or more different statuses, such as Bleed and Expose, each enemy next to it gains them.
relics.was: When your actions kill the third enemy with a status effect this combat, draw 3 and gain 2 card plays.
relics.intrinsic: Chill from Ice ground and Bleed from Coffin Nails count; mixed decks trigger it by accident.
relics.extrinsic: Bleed, Expose, Sunder and Shock spread through crowds.

relics.name: Bloodmoon Chalice
relics.text: When you lose health during your turn, your next attack this turn deals 2 more damage per health lost (max 8 more).
relics.was: The first health-cost card finished at half health or less each combat heals 5, draws 2 and grants 1 card play.
relics.intrinsic: Fire, collisions and Bleed on your own turn pay you back.
relics.extrinsic: Health costs and Empower (health) become damage.

relics.name: Glassway Compass
relics.text: Your Move and Blink can end on your Illusion: you trade places with it instantly, skipping the tiles between.
relics.was: The first Blink each turn creates a 2-health illusion on the tile you left.
relics.extrinsic: Every illusion is a door.
relics.note: Uses the normal Move and Blink destination click; no new action. Moved from legendary to epic: its old effect is half of Eclipse Mantle, which keeps it. Owner review 2026-10-03: a Move trade is a teleport that spends its cheapest route's movement but enters only the landing tile.

relics.name: The Breaking Wheel
relics.text: An enemy colliding on a surface breaks it: Fire deals 3 more damage, Ice gives Freeze, Electrified gives Shock to it and its blocker, Rubble gives Stagger 3.
relics.extrinsic: Every school's ground becomes a collision finisher.
relics.note: The consumed surface is removed. Freeze through collision is strong; it needs Ice at the exact contact tile.

relics.name: Hollow Puppet
relics.text: Your Push and Pull can target your Illusion without damaging it. An Illusion that collides with an enemy shatters, dealing its remaining Health to that enemy instead of Collision damage.
relics.extrinsic: Decoys become thrown weapons.
relics.note: Breaks the no-illusion-displacement rule on purpose, for your own Push and Pull only.

relics.name: Toll of the Late Bell
relics.text: Enemies set to act after your next turn on the Turn Clock are late: your attacks deal them 3 more damage.
relics.intrinsic: Slow enemies are already late in many fights.
relics.extrinsic: Stagger them, Quicken yourself, and they are all late.
relics.note: Shown on the turn order rail: a late enemy's portrait carries the bell.

relics.name: Rosary of Vows
relics.text: At the start of your turn, gain 2 Block for each active Rite you have.
relics.extrinsic: Every Rite also becomes a Block engine.

relics.name: Siege Ram Totem
relics.text: Any enemy that takes Collision damage suffers that much Stagger (within the normal limit).
relics.intrinsic: Enemies that shove you into their allies delay those allies.
relics.extrinsic: Every slam knocks the target back down the turn clock.

relics.name: Echoing Blade
relics.text: When a Follow-up bonus applies, your next card this turn costs 1 less Time and deals 2 more damage.
relics.extrinsic: Follow-ups chain: three-card turns gain the most.

relics.name: Alchemist's Retort
relics.text: Your items' damage, Block, Heal and Stoneskin are increased by half, rounded up.
relics.intrinsic: Every item you find is better.
relics.extrinsic: Item builds turn consumables into centrepieces.

relics.name: Phoenix Ember
relics.text: Gain 1 Defiance this run. When it triggers, Dispel 2 Umbra, place Fire beneath all enemies, draw 3 and gain 3 card plays.
relics.extrinsic: Fire decks turn the rescue into a counterattack.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Worldroot Idol
relics.text: While you stand on Rubble, you may launch a single-target melee or ranged attack from another connected Rubble tile, consuming it.
relics.extrinsic: Rubble networks become a battlefield you attack from anywhere.
relics.note: Kept.

relics.name: Storm Crown
relics.text: Your Chain attacks rebound: after the last hop, the bolt travels back along its route, hitting each enemy again for half damage (rounded down).
relics.was: The first Chain attack each turn that hits 3+ different enemies draws 2 and grants 1 card play.
relics.extrinsic: Every Chain hits each target twice.
relics.note: The rebound doesn't conduct and doesn't count as new hops for Resonant Clapper.

relics.name: Black Sun Dial
relics.text: Consuming a surface stores it (max 3). Your next attack deals 2 more damage per stored surface, and its target gets each one's effect: Fire beneath it, Chilled, Shock, Stagger 2.
relics.was: Once per combat, your first elemental consume on Rubble deals 6 to everyone in a cross and grants 6 Stoneskin.
relics.extrinsic: Spend three schools' ground, then unload it in one hit.
relics.note: Shown on the badge as up to three stored elements.

relics.name: Fivefold Knot
relics.text: Each element you play ties its knot for this combat. With 3 of the 5 knots, your attacks Pierce; with 4, they also gain Chain 1; with all 5, every card you play also grants 3 Block.
relics.was: Once per combat, after you play all 5 elements in one turn, draw 5 and gain 5 card plays.
relics.extrinsic: Five-school decks unlock a new rule every knot.
relics.note: Thresholds instead of a once-per-combat jackpot.

relics.name: Borrowed Hourglass
relics.text: Once per combat, when you end your turn with a card play unused, take another turn at once. Everything it costs is added to your next turn's Time.
relics.was: The first banked card play spent on a Time 7+ card each combat draws 4 and grants 3 card plays.
relics.extrinsic: Spend one play to buy a whole turn ahead of the enemies; Quicken and cheap cards keep the Time debt small.

relics.name: Unclouded Sun
relics.text: Your Light sources are relay points: when you Move, each of them counts as next to every other.
relics.was: Once per combat, when a room that began in Umbra first becomes Clear, gain 12 Stoneskin, draw 3 and gain 3 card plays.
relics.extrinsic: Every Light source is a relay.
relics.note: Owner review 2026-10-03: only Light sources link, so a jump runs relay to relay and the hero walks to and from them; the jump plays as a Blink.

relics.name: Crown of Surplus
relics.text: Cards without their own Empower gain one: Empower (+3 Time): repeat the card's first action. Rite cards, items and Flurry cards are excluded.
relics.extrinsic: Overclock Coil and Quicken pay the Time back.
relics.note: The Time cost is the brake. Enemies act more often against a deck that doubles everything.

relics.name: Mirror Triptych
relics.text: Your first attack card each turn is echoed by up to 3 Illusion at half damage (rounded down). Each hits the nearest enemy it can reach and loses 1 Health.
relics.extrinsic: A hall of mirrors becomes a firing line.
relics.note: Capped at three echoes; echoes wear the illusions down.

relics.name: Liturgy of Ash
relics.text: Rite cards don't use a Card Play.
relics.extrinsic: Every Rite is free tempo; a Rite deck plays two attacks and its Rites each turn.

relics.name: Pyre-Keeper's Urn
relics.text: At the start of your turn, the last card you sent to Exhaust returns to your hand, unless it is a Rite or has Heal.
relics.extrinsic: One-shot cards become every-turn cards.

relics.name: Briar Throne
relics.text: Your Retaliate no longer expires, and grows by 1 each time it triggers. Cards can't give you Block.
relics.extrinsic: Thorns become your whole defence and keep growing all combat.
relics.note: A real trade: no Block from cards. Block from relics, such as Martyr's Gorget and Recoil Plates, still works.

relics.name: Whirling Sash
relics.text: Gain 1 extra card play each turn. Each card after your second each turn costs 2 more Time.
relics.extrinsic: Follow-up, Quicken and cheap cards make the third card nearly free; Flurry repeats once more.

relics.name: Quartermaster's Ledger
relics.text: Your items lose Consume, except items that Heal. Each item can be used once per combat.
relics.extrinsic: Your item loadout becomes a permanent second deck.
relics.note: Healing stays scarce: draughts and elixirs are still Consumed. The Scavenger's item prices may need a look.

relics.name: Ashen Brand
relics.text: Detonate consumes the whole connected Fire cluster. Each extra overlapping blast adds 25% of base damage.
relics.extrinsic: Fire decks shape one huge Detonate.
relics.note: Kept. Rewarded by the Ashen Reaver.

relics.name: Winter's Spur
relics.text: A straight stretch of Ice costs 1 base movement per Move. Turning starts a new stretch.
relics.extrinsic: Ice roads become highways.
relics.note: Kept. Rewarded by Rimejaw.

relics.name: Resonant Clapper
relics.text: Chain gains 25% of base damage for each successive enemy hop.
relics.extrinsic: Long Chains end on big hits.
relics.note: Kept. Rewarded by the Storm Cantor.

relics.name: Galehook Talon
relics.text: Push and Pull move the target's whole contiguous line of enemies together; the group stops at an obstruction.
relics.extrinsic: Lines of enemies slam as one.
relics.note: Kept. Rewarded by the Gallows Roc.

relics.name: Cragbound Gauntlet
relics.text: Your ranged Earth spells raise a 3-health outcrop at an empty ground target.
relics.extrinsic: Every Earth shot builds cover.
relics.note: Kept. Rewarded by Craghide.

relics.name: Procession Lantern
relics.text: Your illusions can use your independent movement.
relics.extrinsic: Decoys walk.
relics.note: Kept. Rewarded by the Last Lamplighter.

relics.name: Crowncoal Heart
relics.text: Each turn, your first single-target hit on ground without an elemental surface leaves Fire. Your first Detonate each turn that consumes 2+ Fire grants 6 Stoneskin.
relics.extrinsic: Attacks lay the fuel.
relics.note: Kept. Vyraketh's trophy.

relics.name: Worldheart
relics.text: At the end of your turn, up to 2 remaining Block becomes Stoneskin. Whenever you gain Stoneskin, deal half that amount (rounded down, max 4) to each adjacent enemy.
relics.extrinsic: Armour becomes thorns.
relics.note: Kept. Tharokh's trophy.

relics.name: Unbound Pinion
relics.text: The first card action each turn that sends an enemy 2 or more tiles, or makes it collide, refills your movement and you Draw 1.
relics.was: The first card action each turn that pushes or pulls an enemy at least 2 tiles refills your movement and draws 1.
relics.extrinsic: A slam refills your legs.
relics.note: Collisions now count, so a fully blocked push still triggers it. Vaeloryx's trophy.

relics.name: Winter's Hourglass
relics.text: Your first Ice card each turn stores 3 Time (max 3). Non-Ice cards spend stored Time to cost less, to a minimum of 1. Stored Time lasts the combat.
relics.extrinsic: Ice pays for everything else.
relics.note: Kept. Iskaldra's trophy.

relics.name: Stormroad Coil
relics.text: Single-target ranged attacks can relay once through Electrified, with normal range on each leg.
relics.extrinsic: Shoot around corners.
relics.note: Kept. Zekarion's trophy.

relics.name: Eclipse Mantle
relics.text: Your first Blink each turn leaves a 2-health illusion at its origin. Your illusions radiate radius-2 Light while they last.
relics.extrinsic: Every Blink leaves a lantern.
relics.note: Kept. Noctyrax's trophy, for the next run.

relics.name: True North
relics.was: While you have Truesight, ranged actions gain +1 range.
relics.note: +1 range while you have Truesight rarely changes a decision, and Truesight is rare.

relics.name: Dawnstitch Cord
relics.was: The first card each turn that creates Light, grants Vision or Truesight, or Dispels Umbra grants 4 Block.
relics.note: A once-per-turn Block tip for Radiance cards. Radiance already has more relics than any other school.

relics.name: Starless Astrolabe
relics.was: While you have Truesight, applying Freeze or Shock creates Light beneath that enemy.
relics.note: Truesight plus Freeze or Shock to make a little Light: three narrow conditions for a small effect.

relics.name: Stormglass Beacon
relics.was: The first Chain attack each turn creates Light beneath every enemy it hits.
relics.note: Light under Chain targets overlaps Brightglass Lens and pays off nothing Lightning wants.

relics.name: Moonless Compass
relics.was: Once per combat, playing separate movement and Light cards in one turn grants 6 Stoneskin and 2 card plays.
relics.note: Once per combat, two card types in one turn: a checklist, not a build.

relics.name: Witchglass Lantern
relics.was: Your illusions have +2 Light radius while they last.
relics.note: Duplicates the Witchlight skill and Eclipse Mantle's Light aura.

relics.name: Glowstone Matrix
relics.was: Cards that grant Stoneskin also grant Vision 1 for 2 turns.
relics.note: Vision on Stoneskin cards joins two unrelated packages for no reason.

relics.name: Open-Eyed Pin
relics.was: When a card grants Vision or Truesight, create radius-1 Light at you for its duration.
relics.note: Light when you gain Vision; Vision cards already light the board.

relics.name: Dawnbrand Filament
relics.was: The first direct attack each turn creates radius-1 Light at its target for 2 turns.
relics.note: Repeats the Dawnbrand skill.

relics.name: Mossbound Wraps
relics.was: The first Earth card you play while you have Block each turn grants 3 Stoneskin.
relics.note: A first-Earth-card trigger for 3 Stoneskin. Grave Dirt and Rubblewalker Greaves do the job without the checklist.

relics.name: Ion Spool
relics.was: The first Lightning attack each turn that conducts through 2+ tiles draws 1.
relics.note: Draw 1 on a conduction count. Grounding Pin changes how you aim instead.

relics.name: Cinderbrand Tongs
relics.was: Your first card each turn to create new Fire also creates radius-1 Light at its target.
relics.note: Light from new Fire. Fire decks want fuel and payoffs, not Light.

builds.name: Wrecking Yard
builds.pitch: Raise outcrops, shove enemies into them, and make every collision leave Rubble that makes the next one hurt more.
builds.line: Earthen Rampart walls the lane. Updraft drives an Ash Hound straight into it: 4 collision damage, 6 with Mason's Plumb, and the wall takes none. Siege Ram Totem Staggers it 6. Millstone Fob leaves Rubble under it, so Quarry Signet adds 1 to everything that hits it next.

builds.name: The Late Bell
builds.pitch: Push enemies down the turn clock, act twice before they do, and punish everyone left waiting.
builds.line: Overhead Smash (7 Time) Staggers 1 through Leaden Pommel and Quickens 2 through Hourglass Splinter. Crushing Blow then costs 3 instead of 5 and Staggers 4. Both targets now act after your next turn, so Toll of the Late Bell adds 3 to every hit on them.

builds.name: Hall of Glass
builds.pitch: Fill the room with decoys that bite, explode, swap with you and shoot back.
builds.line: Hall of Mirrors rings you in glass. Each illusion an enemy breaks shatters for 3 and Staggers its killer. Hollow Puppet throws the survivors, and Mirror Triptych echoes your first attack from three of them.

builds.name: Vigil of Ash
builds.pitch: Open with a Rite every combat, play them for free, and let every Exhaust leave armour.
builds.line: Reliquary Box puts Rite of the Mountain in the opening hand; it costs no play under Liturgy of Ash. Ashen Phylactery turns it into 4 Stoneskin. Each turn after, Rosary of Vows adds 2 Block per Rite.

builds.name: Thornwall
builds.pitch: Hold Block between turns and turn every enemy swing into damage and more Block.
builds.line: Shield Wall plus Briar Vambrace: 9 Block and Retaliate 1. Iron Buckler keeps 3 of it. A Crawler bites into the wall: it Bleeds from Coffin Nails, takes the thorns, and Martyr's Gorget hands the damage back as Block.

builds.name: Bloodprice
builds.pitch: Pay health and Empower on purpose, and cash every point in for damage.
builds.line: Royal Bramble Empowered for 1 health: Bloodmoon Chalice adds 2 to the next attack and Overclock Coil Quickens 2. When health runs low, Iron Lung pays the next cost in Stoneskin instead.

builds.name: Duelist's Step
builds.pitch: Move first, then let both of your cards hit as Follow-ups.
builds.line: Walk 2 tiles, and Feint Ribbon makes Quick Stab a Follow-up on card one. Echoing Blade makes Main-Gauche cheaper and 2 stronger. Whirling Sash adds a third card.

builds.name: Prism
builds.pitch: Mix schools on purpose: alternate elements, overwrite surfaces, and store them for one big release.
builds.line: Frost Lane laid over Kindle's Fire overflows Ice onto the neighbours. Flint Edge spends Fire under one target and Ice under another; Black Sun Dial stores both and releases 4 damage plus Fire and Chill on the next hit.

builds.name: Quartermaster
builds.pitch: Carry a full belt of items and use them as free, oversized, permanent actions.
builds.line: Quick-Draw Bandolier makes Throwing Net a free action. Alchemist's Retort makes Powder Keg's blast 9. Quartermaster's Ledger means they're back next fight.

anchor_slam.name: Anchor Slam
anchor_slam.text: Gain 3 Stoneskin, then pull 2 at range 3 for 5, Sunder 4, and immobilize.

barbed_mail.name: Barbed Mail
barbed_mail.text: Gain 5 Block and Retaliate 3 with Bleed 1.

bloody_lunge.name: Bloody Lunge
bloody_lunge.text: Move 2, then strike for 9. Empower (1 HP): deal 4 more.

borrowed_spark.name: Borrowed Spark
borrowed_spark.text: Exhaust. Lose 1 health. Place a two-tile Fire line at range 3, draw 2, and gain 1 play.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.text: Consume. Leave Rubble in a cross within range 2. Enemies in it Bleed 2.

chain_bolt.name: Chain Bolt
chain_bolt.text: Deal 4 Lightning damage with Chain 2 at range 3. Empower (+2 Time): Chain 4.

clockwork_mark.name: Clockwork Mark
clockwork_mark.text: Deal 4 at range 3 and Stagger 2, then draw 1.

crosswind.name: Crosswind
crosswind.text: Deal 3 at range 3 and push 2 in any direction.

crushing_blow.name: Crushing Blow
crushing_blow.text: Strike an adjacent enemy for 8 and Stagger 3.

crystal_mantle.name: Crystal Mantle
crystal_mantle.text: Exhaust. Gain 3 Mantle: each direct hit against you breaks one Mantle instead of dealing damage.

daybreak.name: Daybreak
daybreak.text: Exhaust. Reduce the Umbra by 2 stages, draw 2, and gain 1 card play.

doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
doppelganger.text: Create a 5-health illusion within range 3. While it lives, you may fire ranged attacks from its tile.

earthen_rampart.name: Earthen Rampart
earthen_rampart.text: Raise outcrops on a three-tile line within range 2, then gain 3 Stoneskin. Empower (Exhaust): the line is five tiles.

empty_husk.name: Empty Husk
empty_husk.text: Swap places with one of your illusions. Your Block moves onto it as extra health.

fault_strike.name: Fault Strike
fault_strike.text: Strike for 11, then leave Rubble on the target's tile and the two tiles behind it.

forked_nock.name: Forked Nock
forked_nock.text: Deal 3 Lightning damage with Chain 2 at range 3 and Expose 2.

frost_lane.name: Frost Lane
frost_lane.text: Leave Ice on a three-tile line within range 3, then draw 1.

geode.name: Geode
geode.text: Raise an outcrop within range 2, then gain 3 Stoneskin.

glassbone_guard.name: Glassbone Guard
glassbone_guard.text: Lose 1 health. Gain 6 Stoneskin, then draw 1.

hall_of_mirrors.name: Hall of Mirrors
hall_of_mirrors.text: Create a 2-health illusion on each empty tile next to you, then gain 3 Block.

hamstring_slice.name: Spur Trip
hamstring_slice.text: Move 2, then strike an adjacent enemy for 5 and immobilize.

headlong.name: Headlong
headlong.text: Move 4. Your next attack this turn deals 1 more for each tile you moved this turn (maximum 4).

kestrel_dive.name: Kestrel Dive
kestrel_dive.text: Blink 3, then strike an adjacent enemy for 5 and push 1.

kindle.name: Kindle
kindle.text: Place Fire on a tile within range 3, then draw 1.

lamp_oil.name: Lamp Oil
lamp_oil.text: Consume. Leave Fire on a three-tile line within range 3.

magma_vent.name: Magma Vent
magma_vent.text: Consume a Rubble tile within range 3 to deal 5 there and to its four neighbors, then leave Fire there.

main_gauche.name: Main-Gauche
main_gauche.text: Strike an adjacent enemy for 3. Follow-up: deal 3 more and draw 1.

mirror_feint.name: Mirror Feint
mirror_feint.text: Create a 3-health illusion next to an enemy within range 3. That enemy is Exposed 3.

overclock.name: Overclock
overclock.text: Draw 1 and gain 1 card play. Empower (1 HP): draw 2 instead.

overhead_smash.name: Overhead Smash
overhead_smash.text: Strike an adjacent enemy for 12. Empower (+2 Time): Stagger 4.

palm_strike.name: Palm Strike
palm_strike.text: Strike an adjacent enemy for 4. Follow-up: deal 3 more and push 1.

phoenix_cleave.name: Phoenix Cleave
phoenix_cleave.text: Exhaust. Lose 1 health. Strike adjacent tiles for 10, then Detonate 10 on those tiles.

powder_keg.name: Powder Keg
powder_keg.text: Consume. Place a 3-health keg within range 2. When destroyed, it deals 6 to its tile and each tile next to it.

quarry_step.name: Quarry Step
quarry_step.text: Move 2, then strike for 6 and leave Rubble beneath the target.

quick_stab.name: Quick Stab
quick_stab.text: Strike an adjacent enemy for 6. Follow-up: deal 3 more.

raise_stone.name: Raise Stone
raise_stone.text: Raise a 3-health outcrop on an empty tile within range 3, then draw 1.

razor_gale.name: Razor Gale
razor_gale.text: Flurry. Deal 2 at range 2 and push 1 for each card play spent.

reflected_threat.name: Reflected Threat
reflected_threat.text: Create a 4-health illusion within range 3. Enemies that damage it take that much damage too.

reprise.name: Reprise
reprise.text: Lose 1 health. Draw 4 and gain 5 Block.

rime_hack.name: Rime Hack
rime_hack.text: Strike for 5 Ice damage, then leave Ice beneath the target.

riposte_lunge.name: Riposte Lunge
riposte_lunge.text: Move 2, then strike for 5. Retaliate 4 until your next turn.

rite_of_hoarfrost.name: Rite of Hoarfrost
rite_of_hoarfrost.text: Rite: whenever you Freeze an enemy, gain 3 Block and draw 1.

rite_of_the_mountain.name: Rite of the Mountain
rite_of_the_mountain.text: Rite: at the start of each of your turns, gain 3 Stoneskin.

rite_of_the_pyre.name: Rite of the Pyre
rite_of_the_pyre.text: Rite: your Fire tiles deal 2 more damage.

royal_bramble.name: Royal Bramble
royal_bramble.text: Pull 2 at range 2 for 4 and Bleed 2. Empower (1 HP): Expose 4 and Sunder 4.

salamander_heart.name: Salamander Heart
salamander_heart.text: Rite: you ignore Fire damage. At the start of your turn, if you stand on Fire, gain 3 Stoneskin and draw 1.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.text: Deal 5 Ice damage at range 3. If the target was Frozen, also deal 5 to each enemy next to it.

shield_charge.name: Shield Charge
shield_charge.text: Move 2, then bash an adjacent enemy for 3 and push 2.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.text: Gain 9 Block. You can't Move, Blink or Swap for the rest of this turn.

skybolt.name: Skybolt
skybolt.text: Deal 7 Lightning damage to any enemy you can see, ignoring range and line of sight. It conducts; everything it hits is Shocked.

sleet_squall.name: Sleet Squall
sleet_squall.text: Push 2 at range 3, then deal 3 Ice damage to the target.

snare_coil.name: Snare Coil
snare_coil.text: Pull 3 at range 3 for 2, then immobilize.

spark_dart.name: Spark Dart
spark_dart.text: Deal 4 Lightning damage at range 3, then leave Electrified and radius-1 Light for 2 turns.

static_rush.name: Static Rush
static_rush.text: Move 2. Quicken 2: your next card this turn costs 2 less Time.

static_ward.name: Static Ward
static_ward.text: Gain 5 Block, then Electrify your tile and the tile of each adjacent enemy.

stolen_moment.name: Stolen Moment
stolen_moment.text: Quicken 3: your next card this turn costs 3 less Time. Draw 1.

stonefist.name: Stonefist
stonefist.text: Strike for 5, plus 1 for each Stoneskin you have (maximum 6 more).

straw_double.name: Straw Double
straw_double.text: Create a 2-health illusion next to you, then draw 1.

tectonic_maul.name: Tectonic Maul
tectonic_maul.text: Move 1, then strike for 11, or 15 against a target on Rubble. Leave a cross of Rubble at the impact and Stagger 3.

throwing_net.name: Throwing Net
throwing_net.text: Consume. Immobilize an enemy within range 3 and Stagger 3.

thunderstone.name: Thunderstone
thunderstone.text: Consume. Deal 5 Lightning damage to any enemy you can see, ignoring line of sight. Stagger 2.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.text: Deal 3 to each enemy within 2 tiles of you and Stagger 2. Empower (+2 Time): Stagger 4.

unsealed_gale.name: Unsealed Gale
unsealed_gale.text: Exhaust. Push every enemy within 3 of you 3 tiles away.

volt_surge.name: Volt Surge
volt_surge.text: Deal 3 Lightning damage along a three-tile line at range 2, then leave Electrified.

vortex.name: Vortex
vortex.text: Choose a tile within range 3. Pull each enemy within 2 of it 2 tiles toward it.

wildfire_halo.name: Wildfire Halo
wildfire_halo.text: Deal 4 in a large pattern at range 2, then Detonate 10 in that pattern.
